主要内容: On May 18, 2017, the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctioned eight members of Venezuela’s Supreme Court of Justice (TSJ) under Executive Order 13692. These officials, including the President of the TSJ, Maikel Jose Moreno Perez, and seven members of the TSJ’s Constitutional Chamber, were targeted for their role in undermining Venezuela’s National Assembly, the democratically elected legislative body. The TSJ-C has issued rulings that allowed the Executive Branch to bypass the National Assembly, such as permitting President Nicolas Maduro to address the TSJ instead of the National Assembly and exempting the Executive from submitting the budget to the National Assembly. These actions have restricted the rights of the Venezuelan people and weakened democratic governance. As a result of the sanctions, the assets of the designated individuals are frozen, and U.S. persons are prohibited from engaging in transactions with them. The Treasury emphasized that these measures support the Venezuelan people in their efforts to protect democratic governance. The U.S. Treasury sanctioned eight members of Venezuela’s Supreme Court of Justice, in consultation with the State Department, pursuant to Executive Order 13692. The U.S. government continues to call on the Venezuelan government to permit the democratically-elected National Assembly to perform its constitutional functions.

股票实体.名称: U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
